Catalog highway sequence is not present in the cached byway article; precise northern highway instructions omitted. Overview follows material’s north-to-south strip order; dam precedes Truth or Consequences, then Kingston.
Tourism copy calls the desert Chiricahua Desert and describes reaching wilderness. Desert proper name and any suggestion of driving inside designated wilderness omitted; terrain retained.
Hillsboro page dates county-seat transfer to 1936; Truth or Consequences page gives 1937. Transfer date omitted pending reconciliation.
Kingston page distinguishes an 1880 district discovery from Sheddon’s 1882 Solitaire discovery. The specific 1882 event is used; not presented as the first silver discovery anywhere in the district.
FHWA’s 154-mile designated length differs from material’s 149.4 mapped miles; federal figure and backtracking allowance explicitly attributed.
No Apache community source is cached for the claimed use of hot springs by Geronimo and his warriors. That tourism assertion is omitted; only the commemorative name is retained.
